notes: Universitywide and NUpath requirements are referenced but not fully expanded.
Placement substitutions, open elective ranges, grade policies and reuse restrictions require individual review.

Transfer students must complete at least five four-semester-hour JRNL courses at Northeastern, including JRNL 2201, JRNL 2301 and JRNL 4650. This residency condition is a note, not an additional unconditional course set.
Three JRNL elective courses form an open pool; C-or-higher thresholds apply to specified core courses and a 2.000 GPA to all JRNL courses.
JRNL 2301 also fulfills advanced writing; CY 4170 and integrative choices can overlap other lists. Individual double-counting and eligibility require review.
Semester-hour units are explicit in the catalog. Published degree totals and category allocations are source rules, not calculated inventory sums.
Course categories are editorial. Source-stated outcomes are paraphrased program aims, not measured graduate outcomes.
The local curriculum is represented; the degree remains partial because full universitywide and conditional policy execution has not been established.

Official subject-catalog metadata checked for 18 courses; each course cites that source. Variable subject-catalog credit ranges remain null in scalar credits, while program-specific required credits remain on their requirement nodes.
